question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Ivanhoe, Bob gets Dracula, Claire gets Hamlet, Dave gets Siddhartha, Eve gets Candide, Fred gets Emma, and Gertrude gets Beloved.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Dave and Eve swap books. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Fred swap books. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap books. Then, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap books. Finally, Gertrude and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Gertrude has
Options:
(A) Ivanhoe
(B) Dracula
(C) Hamlet
(D) Siddhartha
(E) Candide
(F) Emma
(G) Beloved
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (Ivanhoe, Dracula, Hamlet, Siddhartha, Candide, Emma, Beloved)
1. Dave and Eve swap: (Ivanhoe, Dracula, Hamlet, Candide, Siddhartha, Emma, Beloved)
2. Gertrude and Bob swap: (Ivanhoe, Beloved, Hamlet, Candide, Siddhartha, Emma, Dracula)
3. Bob and Fred swap: (Ivanhoe, Emma, Hamlet, Candide, Siddhartha, Beloved, Dracula)
4. Eve and Gertrude swap: (Ivanhoe, Emma, Hamlet, Candide, Dracula, Beloved, Siddhartha)
5. Alice and Bob swap: (Emma, Ivanhoe, Hamlet, Candide, Dracula, Beloved, Siddhartha)
6. Alice and Gertrude swap: (Siddhartha, Ivanhoe, Hamlet, Candide, Dracula, Beloved, Emma)
7. Gertrude and Alice swap: (Emma, Ivanhoe, Hamlet, Candide, Dracula, Beloved, Siddhartha)
Gertrude has Siddhartha, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
